scope: Supplementary post-hoc permutation test on dev_confirm (n=6,417)
caveats: Macro-F1 permutation test specified as a supplementary post-hoc analysis
dev_confirm is a development-confirmation split (not a blind test)
McNemar and group sign-flip tests evaluate Accuracy; this script supplements them with Macro-F1 paired group permutation tests
Group bootstrap intervals are retained from t1_score.py
No retraining, no model edits, and no access to held-out post-2023 records
